title: Carnegie Mellon alums star in new CBS legal drama 'Cupertino'

 Finch Walker USA TODAY NETWORK Nov. 5, 2026, 2:58 a.m. ET Hear this story A new CBS legal drama, "Cupertino," stars two graduates from Carnegie Mellon University.
 The show follows a lawyer taking on a powerful tech giant in Silicon Valley.
 Alums Rachel Keller and Renée Elise Goldsberry both have key roles in the series.
 A new legal drama that premiered this fall on CBS stars two graduates from Carnegie Mellon University in Pittsburgh .
 The show, " Cupertino ," premiered in early October. Created by Michelle and Robert King and starring Mike Colter, Rachel Keller and Ella Stiller, the show is set to include 20 episodes in its first season, according to IMDb .
 Here's where to watch it — and the CMU graduates you'll see in key roles.
 What is 'Cupertino' about?
 "Cupertino" is a legal drama on CBS that debuted in 2026. The show follows a "scrappy lawyer" as she "takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights," according to IMDb.
 Watch it here: Stream your favorite shows, the biggest blockbusters and more. Carnegie Mellon alums Rachel Keller, Renée Elise Goldsberry star in CBS show 'Cupertino'
 Keller, who stars as one of the leads in "Cupertino," is a Carnegie Mellon University alum, according to Paramount , with TribLIVE reporting that she graduated in 2014.
 She isn't the only CMU grad to star in the show. Renée Elise Goldsberry, who plays attorney Nichole E. Ferebee, also attended Carnegie Mellon University, where she received a bachelors degree in acting, according to her IMDb page .
 Goldsberry graduated from CMU in 1993, TribLIVE reported.
 When is 'Cupertino' on?
 New "Cupertino" episodes come out every Thursday at 10 p.m. Eastern Time. The show premiered on Oct. 8.
 Where to watch, stream 'Cupertino'
 New "Cupertino" episodes premiere weekly on CBS. Episodes can also be streamed on Paramount+.
